title: Sync with your account
lead: Your projects sync with {url} through your OctopusOn SEO account on their own: projects, settings, keywords, AI questions, reports and measurement history are the same everywhere. Your own API keys stay on this computer.
webLead: Sign in to the desktop program with the same account and its projects come here, and these go there, on their own.
error: The last try failed: {error}. It will try again on its own.
scheduleNote: While syncing, scheduled work (rank tracking, AI visibility, audits, Search Console) runs on the web server, even while your computer is off. It is paid with credits or with keys you entered on the web. What you start by hand runs here.
scheduleOnWeb: Sync is on: scheduled checks run on the web server.
chosen: Your choice is saved; syncing starts shortly.
reason_first: This computer has {here} projects and the web has {web}. Choose what happens before the first sync.
reason_account: This computer synced with another OctopusOn SEO account before. Choose what happens with the account connected now. (This computer has {here} projects, this account's web {web}.)
reason_reset: The web's sync records started over (its data may have been restored from a backup). This computer has {here} projects and the web has {web}. Choose what happens.
mergeText: Every project of both sides is everywhere. The same domain may end up with two projects; delete the extra one later.
upload: Replace the web's with this computer's
uploadText: The {web} projects on the web are deleted; this computer's {here} projects are sent there.
uploadTextConfirm: The projects on the web and their history will be deleted. Continue?
download: Replace this computer's with the web's
downloadText: The {here} projects on this computer are deleted; the web's {web} projects come here.
downloadTextConfirm: The projects on this computer and their history will be deleted. Continue?
